==Recent Edits==
Not that I care if you change "try and" to "try to", but if you've read the books you'll notice that both Robert Jordan and Brandon Sanderson have used "try and". Since it made it past the editors, I daresay that "try and" isn't as egregious an error as you make it out to be. [[User:Ninjatacoshell|Ninjatacoshell]] 21:22, November 25, 2009 (UTC)
